admission.justification: Disposable acknowledgement storage must remain a locked current set rather than unbounded history or a per-tick rewrite. The store fold/upsert/reconcile implementation and compact-history/no-write/failure assertions guard a persistent resource and concurrency boundary.

applicability: The disposable current attention acknowledgement set stored in workspace/attention-dismissals.jsonl by AttentionDismissalStore.
conditions: Upsert and reconcile hold the store write lock across read/fold/rewrite; itemId is the single current key.
An unchanged pass means the current parsed/folded acknowledgement set and its identities do not change; duplicate normalization or first fingerprint adoption may legitimately require a write.
exclusions: Append-only audit or canonical task/gate/workspace event history.
Preservation of malformed or removed-kind legacy lines, or an assertion that a normalization pass is physically unchanged.

evidence: sync-L81-primary-regressions.txt; long10000sessions/1000worktrees history; locked concurrent click tests

statement: The compact dismissal file holds at most one live acknowledgement per current thing, and an unchanged pass writes nothing.
